content_zh:
「莹莹，你的确聪明，你全猜对了。我的确还爱着你大哥，只是一口气还咽不下罢了。」裴璎珞坦承自己的心意。

「那大嫂是真的想嫁给别人吗？」该不会真的为了赌气就做出糊涂事来吧？

「没有。黎大哥是我大哥的好友，特地陪我演出这场戏，目的是要让你大哥知难而退；没想到你大哥竟过分地点住我的睡穴，将我强掳来这里。」

说到这里，她更是气上加气。她原本是打算放出她和黎大哥要成亲的假消息，然后将慕容彻给气跑。一方面是为自己出一口气，另一方面冷静想想自己与慕容彻这段感情该如何处理，没想到那个可恶的男人会做出连夜掳人这种事来。

「大嫂，大哥强横惯了，的确是该受点教训。」慕容莹拍手，十分赞同她的做法。难得出现一个即使大哥在忿怒之下也动不了的人，也该让大哥尝尝苦头才行。「只是大嫂，如果你气消后，打算原谅大哥时，可否帮我一个忙？」

「什么忙？」裴璎珞好奇地看着她双手合十，一脸请求。

慕容莹白净的小脸一红，在她耳畔低语后，随即羞涩地垂下头来。

裴璎珞柔美的脸上扬起一抹笑，一口承诺道：「好，我一定帮你这个忙。」

「谢谢大嫂！」

慕容莹开心地抱住她，真心喜欢这个温柔善良的大嫂。人说长嫂如母，她开始有这种感觉了，暗忖大哥好眼光。

夜凉如水，尤其灵山岛在入夜后，更添一抹寒意。

小伶在侍候裴璎珞沐浴梳洗后，确定每扇窗棂都关上后，这才离开。

裴璎珞正欲上床休息，房门在此时被推了开来，她原以为是小伶，没想到进来的却是一抹挺拔修长的身形。

「慕容公子，你是否走错房了？你的寝房在隔壁。」裴璎珞冷淡地说，注意到一向挂在他脸上的笑消失了，俊脸深沉莫测地盯视着她。

他今晚怎么了？

「你应该很清楚，我不可能让你嫁给别人。」慕容彻一步一步逼近她，黑眸狂乱地锁住她。

「慕容公子，你到底想做什么？夜深了，请你马上出去！」他身上传来的浓浓酒味，还有他此刻异常的神情令她害怕，身形一闪，就想逃离开这间房。

可惜她的动作不够快，不仅被他快一步捉住，娇躯更是被他打横抱起走向床榻。

「放开我！你想做什么？！」裴璎珞被他的举动吓到了，在他怀中拚命地挣扎。

「我曾经不齿穆香慈卑鄙的行径，不过如果能造成既定的事实，能让你永远属于我，那有何不可呢？更何况我从来就不承认自己是正人君子。」

他被她一再地漠视，还有一再坚决要嫁给别人的话给气疯了。忍了一个月，他的耐心用尽，再也无法忍受她的疏离和冰冷了。

将她柔软的身子压向床榻，双手随即迅速扯落她身上的衣裳，当衣裳一件件被他扯落床榻下，只剩下她的贴身抹胸和亵裤，薄唇吻上她雪白柔嫩的胸前，一声委屈的啜泣同时在他头上响起。

如同被泼了冰水般，令他瞬间惊醒，抬起头即看到一张梨花带泪的小脸，还有一双含怨的杏眸。

慕容彻叹了口气，终究是不忍伤害她，将她娇躯扶抱起，坐在他怀里，薄唇心疼地吻上她脸上的泪水，歉疚的话同时响起：

「对不起，我气得失去理智了。我从来没有想过要这样伤害你，只是听你一再说要嫁给别人，才会让我气疯了。」

想他慕容彻从小到大何曾这样低声下气过，可遇上这样一个看似温婉好脾气、实则是外柔内刚有副倔性子的人儿，也只能认栽了。

「你太可恶了！可恶至极！」一双小拳头气得往他胸膛捶打，伴随着她委屈的哽咽声。「先是不听我的解释误会我，还用恶毒的话伤害我，之后又不顾我的意愿，将我强掳来这里，现在又打算强占我身子，你堂堂慕容少主，何时变得这么蛮横如同强盗土匪般的行径，你太过分了！」

「对不起，璎珞。我宁可你像现在这样打我、骂我，和我吵架，也不要你待我像陌生人还不如。你的彻底漠视、冰冷疏离，令我心慌害怕，我怕我真的会失去你，怕你永远也不肯原谅我。璎珞，答应我好吗？以后不管对我再生气，也不要用这种冰冷疏离的态度对我，好吗？」

慕容彻一双大掌包覆住她的小手，薄唇吻遍她的小脸，轻吻过她颤抖的朱唇，软声请求。

「我才不习惯和人吵架，也没有骂人、打人的习惯。」就是因为没有这些习惯，却又咽不下这口气，只好用视而不见来表达自己的怒气。

「璎珞，嫁给我好吗？别再和我呕气了。」慕容彻看出她的态度软化，薄唇诱哄地在她耳畔低喃。

「这件事急不得，我要再想想。」原本她已打算要原谅他了，可现在他又这样对她，这口气更难咽下了。

「慕容彻……你……」裴璎珞抗议不及，神智逐渐模糊。

「叫我彻。」

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

「我可以给你时间慢慢想，但条件是你必须在我怀里想。」

裴璎珞累得全身无力。这个男人摆明是吃定她了，可恶！

「等你想通了，我们就成亲。」慕容彻脸上重新扬起笑容，这笑容是满足的。

「好，当我出嫁那天，我要莹莹和我同一天出嫁。」杏眸睁开，眸底有丝气恼。

含笑的黑眸对上她微愠的杏眸，脸上的笑容加深了，大掌轻抚她因欢爱而红艳的小脸。

「你这个大嫂当得可真尽责，也难怪莹莹那丫头那么喜欢你。好，我答应你。」

结实的身躯重新压上令他爱不释手的柔软娇躯，也适时张嘴堵住她的抗议，夜还长得很呢。

这算不算是两只笑面狐狸对决？

「慕容兄，既然大家即将成为亲家，那么与灵凤轩合作的事，相信慕容兄没有理由拒绝了？」裴琥珀笑着替他斟了杯酒。

「裴兄说的是。就不知裴兄想要怎么合作？」慕容彻接过酒杯，一饮而尽。

「好说。希望慕容兄每月提供三十件水晶饰品给珠玉阁贩售，利润六、四分帐如何？」裴琥珀笑得一脸温和，主动替他夹菜。

「何谓六、四分帐？」慕容彻同样笑得一脸无害，客气地询问。

「自是你六我四，如何？」

慕容彻笑了出来，也夹了些菜到他碗里。「裴兄对这桩无本生意是否会觉得赚得太多了呢？」

「那慕容兄有何看法？」裴琥珀笑着反问。

「若是八、二分帐，我倒是可以考虑。」慕容彻黑眸透着精光，望着同样一张笑脸的男人。

「唉！慕容兄，我是真的很想和你尽快成为亲家，虽然爹娘不再气你私自掳走璎珞，又让她怀了一个月的身孕才回来提亲，也同意你们半个月后成亲；但你也知道这婚事筹备可快可慢，就怕这半个月不够啊！」裴琥珀眉头微拧，一脸忧心。

「裴兄，我可以同意六、四分帐；不过珠玉阁的饰品，必须以同等数量摆放在灵凤轩，一样是六、四分帐如何？」慕容彻替他斟了杯酒，笑着提出条件。

「这……」裴琥珀笑而不答，状似思考。

「灵山岛风景秀丽，一年四季皆有不同的景观，随时欢迎裴兄莅临。」慕容彻笑着邀请，毕竟灵山岛乃慕容家所有，若未获得允许，谁也无法进入。

"Yingying, you are indeed smart. You guessed it all right. I do still love your brother, but I just can't hold it in my mouth." Pei Yingluo confessed her feelings.

"Does the sister-in-law really want to marry someone else?" Is she really doing stupid things just to get angry?

"No. Brother Li is my eldest brother's friend. He specially performed this scene with me. The purpose was to make your eldest brother retreat. Unexpectedly, your eldest brother went too far and went to my sleeping hole and kidnapped me here."

Speaking of this, she became even more angry.She originally planned to release false news that she and Brother Li were getting married, and then make Murong Che angry.On the one hand, he wanted to take a breath for himself, and on the other hand, he calmly thought about how to deal with his relationship with Murong Che. He didn't expect that hateful man to do such a thing as kidnapping someone overnight.

"Sister-in-law, my eldest brother is used to being tyrannical. He really deserves to be taught a lesson." Murong Ying clapped her hands and fully agreed with her actions.It's rare for someone to appear who can't move even when the elder brother is angry, so the elder brother should be given a taste of the pain."It's just sister-in-law, if you plan to forgive my brother after you're angry, can you do me a favor?"

"What's the deal?" Pei Yingluo looked at her clasped hands curiously, with a begging look on her face.

Murong Ying's fair face flushed, and after whispering in her ear, she lowered her head shyly.

A smile appeared on Pei Yingluo's soft face, and she promised: "Okay, I will definitely help you with this."

"Thank you, sister-in-law!"

Murong Ying hugged her happily, truly liking this gentle and kind sister-in-law.People say that a sister-in-law is like a mother. She started to feel this way, secretly thinking that her eldest brother had good taste.

The night is as cold as water, especially on Lingshan Island, which adds a touch of chill after nightfall.

Xiaoling waited on Pei Yingluo to bathe and freshen up, and then left after making sure every window was closed.

Pei Yingluo was about to go to bed when the door was pushed open. She originally thought it was Xiaoling, but she didn't expect that a tall and slender figure came in.

"Mr. Murong, did you go to the wrong room? Your bedroom is next door." Pei Yingluo said coldly, noticing that the smile that had always been on his face disappeared, and his handsome face stared at her with a deep and unpredictable expression.

What happened to him tonight?

"You should know very well that there is no way I will let you marry someone else." Murong Che approached her step by step, his black eyes locked on hers wildly.

"Mr. Murong, what do you want to do? It's late at night, please go out right away!" The strong smell of alcohol coming from him and his abnormal expression at the moment frightened her, and she wanted to escape from the room in a flash.

It's a pity that she didn't move fast enough. He not only caught her in one step, but also carried her delicate body horizontally and carried her to the bed.

"Let me go! What do you want to do?!" Pei Yingluo was frightened by his actions and struggled desperately in his arms.

"I used to despise Mu Xiangci's despicable behavior, but if it can create an established fact and make you belong to me forever, then why not? What's more, I have never admitted that I am a gentleman."

He was driven crazy by her repeated disregard and insistence on marrying someone else.After enduring it for a month, his patience was exhausted and he could no longer bear her alienation and coldness.

Pressing her soft body against the bed, he quickly pulled off her clothes with both hands. When he pulled the clothes off the bed one by one, leaving only her tight-fitting bra and panties, he kissed her white and tender chest with his thin lips, and a sob of grievance sounded on his head at the same time.

As if he had been splashed with ice water, he woke up instantly. When he raised his head, he saw a tearful face and a pair of resentful almond eyes.

Murong Che sighed. After all, he couldn't bear to hurt her. He picked up her delicate body and sat in his arms. He kissed the tears on her face with his thin lips and said apologetic words at the same time:

"I'm sorry, I lost my mind with anger. I never wanted to hurt you like this. It was just hearing you repeatedly saying that you wanted to marry someone else made me mad."

I don't think Murong Che has ever been so humble since he was a child, but when he met such a person who seemed gentle and good-tempered, but was actually soft on the outside but stubborn on the inside, he had no choice but to admit defeat.

"You're so hateful! You're so hateful!" A pair of small fists beat him on the chest in anger, accompanied by her grievances and choking sounds."First you didn't listen to my explanation and misunderstood me, and you hurt me with vicious words. Then you ignored my wishes and kidnapped me here. Now you plan to take my body by force. When did you, the majestic Young Master Murong, become so arrogant and act like a robber and bandit? You are going too far!"

"I'm sorry, Yingluo. I would rather you hit me, scold me, and quarrel with me like you do now than treat me like a stranger. Your complete indifference and coldness and alienation make me panic and scared. I'm afraid that I will really lose you and that you will never forgive me. Yingluo, please promise me. No matter how angry you are with me in the future, don't treat me with such a cold and alienated attitude, okay?"

Murong Che wrapped his big palms around her little hands, kissed her little face with his thin lips, kissed her trembling red lips lightly, and asked softly.

"I'm not used to quarreling with others, and I don't have the habit of swearing or hitting others." Because I don't have these habits, but I can't swallow this breath, I have to turn a blind eye to express my anger.

"Yingluo, will you marry me? Don't get angry with me anymore." Murong Che saw her attitude softening, and whispered coaxingly into her ear with his thin lips.

"This matter can't be rushed. I want to think about it again." Originally, she had planned to forgive him, but now that he was treating her like this, it was even harder to swallow.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

"Murong Che...you..." Pei Yingluo couldn't protest, and her consciousness gradually became blurred.

"Call me Tooru."

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

"I can give you time to think slowly, but the condition is that you must think in my arms."

Pei Yingluo was so tired that she felt weak all over.This man clearly has her in his sights, damn it!

"When you figure it out, we will get married." A smile appeared on Murong Che's face again, and this smile was one of satisfaction.

"Okay, when I get married, I want Yingying to get married on the same day as me." Apricot eyes opened, with a trace of anger in them.

His smiling black eyes met her slightly gloomy almond eyes, the smile on his face deepened, and his big palm gently caressed her little face that was red with love.

"You are such a responsible sister-in-law. It's no wonder that girl Yingying likes you so much. Okay, I promise you."

The strong body once again pressed against the soft and delicate body that he couldn't put down, and he opened his mouth in time to block her protest. The night was still very long.

Is this a duel between two smiling foxes?

"Brother Murong, since we are about to become in-laws, I believe Brother Murong has no reason to refuse the cooperation with Lingfengxuan?" Pei Hubo smiled and poured a glass of wine for him.

"That's what Brother Pei said. I wonder how Brother Pei wants to cooperate?" Murong Che took the glass and drank it in one gulp.

"Easy to say. I hope Brother Murong will provide 30 pieces of crystal jewelry for Zhuyu Pavilion to sell every month. How about 60% or 40% of the profit?" Pei Amber smiled gently and took the initiative to pick up food for him.

"What do you mean by six or four accounts?" Murong Che also asked politely with a harmless smile on his face.

"You're six and I'm four, how about that?"

Murong Che laughed and put some vegetables into his bowl."Brother Pei, do you think you are making too much money from this business without capital?"

"What do you think of Brother Murong?" Pei Amber asked with a smile.

"If it's eight or two points, I can consider it." Murong Che's black eyes were shining, looking at the man with the same smiling face.

"Oh! Brother Murong, I really want to become in-laws with you as soon as possible. Although my parents are no longer angry with you for taking Yingluo privately and making her pregnant for a month before coming back to propose marriage, they agree that you two will get married in half a month. But you also know that preparations for the marriage can be fast or slow, and I am afraid that half a month is not enough!" Pei Amber frowned slightly, with a worried look on his face.

"Brother Pei, I can agree to six or four divided accounts; however, the jewelry of Zhuyu Pavilion must be placed in Lingfeng Pavilion in equal quantities. How about the same six or four divided accounts?" Murong Che poured a glass of wine for him and made the condition with a smile.

"This..." Pei Hubo smiled but did not answer, as if thinking.

"Lingshan Island has beautiful scenery, with different landscapes throughout the year. Brother Pei is welcome to visit at any time." Murong Che invited with a smile. After all, Lingshan Island is owned by the Murong family, and no one can enter without permission.
